audio_description:
A sleek Esthar gateway arch stands over a hexagonal platform.
The vast blue-green spires of Esthar shimmer into view above a desolate plain.

context.scene_title: Esthar revealed — the hidden, cloaked futuristic city shimmers into view over the wasteland (Disc 3).
locations: The approach to Esthar — a barren rocky wasteland from which the translucent, camouflaged city of Esthar materializes; an Esthar transport gateway with a hexagonal platform
context.summary: A sleek Esthar gateway arch stands over a hexagonal platform, then the view reveals the vast, glassy blue-green spires of Esthar shimmering as its camouflage cloak parts above a desolate plain — the first reveal of the advanced hidden city.
context.context_note: High confidence: the reveal of Esthar, the cloaked high-tech city (Disc 3).
